You apply to jobs you’re qualified for, jobs you’re overqualified for, and jobs that somehow want a junior employee with senior trauma. Then the bots reject you, recruiters ghost you, and rent acts like it has a guaranteed salary. So yeah. We made a coin. Still applying. Still bullish.
